qualification: negative local production-admission evidence; not correctness, performance, hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

candidateAdmission.boundedRule: The candidate admitted only long-mode CPL0 reads of CR3; other control-register reads, all control-register writes, and user-mode reads continued through the interpreter.
candidateAdmission.implementation: An explicit readControlRegister IR statement loaded the exact immutable dispatch-entry CR3 snapshot appended at context ABI word 50. Both native emitters supported the operation, and the optimizer invalidated equivalent cached values across the read.
candidateAdmission.withdrawal: The production admission was reverted after the pinned full workload reproduced the NX init-text panic. Both measured sites remain deferred.

verificationBeforeProduction.dbtAndPCGate: 1,442 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent
verificationBeforeProduction.differentialCoverage: Both measured kernel sites matched the interpreter in the legacy baseline and tier-one emitters; CR0 remained on the helper path, and CPL3 admission declined without publishing state.
verificationBeforeProduction.flagsCoverage: A compare-to-CR3-read-to-Jcc block preserved the eligible native condition and matched the interpreter.
verificationBeforeProduction.optimizerCoverage: The optimizer invalidated cached control-register values at the explicit read boundary.
verificationBeforeProduction.interpretation: The passing local differentials were insufficient to establish safe production admission.

failure.type: supervisor instruction fetch from an NX-protected init-text page
failure.context: A timer interrupt arrived while free_init_pages was reaching set_memory_nx; the fatal exception in interrupt reset the guest before it emitted an authenticated receipt.
failure.signature: The address and free_init_pages/set_memory_nx call path exactly match the rejected memory-SETcc admission, despite this candidate adding only a read-only register operation.

verificationAfterWithdrawal.dbtAndPCGate: 1,441 tests in 171 suites passed after reverting the candidate; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent
verificationAfterWithdrawal.knownGoodState: The source tree again contains the bounded byte-XOR admission and no native control-register-read admission.

interpretation: A read-only, exact-semantics CR3 candidate passed focused and aggregate differentials but failed the pinned production workload with the same NX init-text signature as unrelated write admissions. This points investigation away from memory-write semantics alone and toward an admission, tier-transition, or interrupt interaction, but it does not establish a cause. The implementation was withdrawn, the known-good aggregate gate is green, and both sites remain deferred.
limitations: The failure was observed in one local pinned-fixture production run, though its signature exactly matches other rejected admission experiments.
The raw diagnostic remains a local build artifact and is not committed because it includes host-local paths and a large console transcript.
No causal mechanism has yet been isolated between the CR3-read admission and the later init-text execution fault.
This rejected record supports neither a correctness claim nor a performance comparison.
